# Andy Chen 陳奕翔

> Software engineer in Taipei, Taiwan, specializing in production LLM systems: vLLM scheduler and GPU-kernel optimization, large-scale RAG, OCR platforms, and ML infrastructure. B.S. in Computer Science and Information Engineering from National Taipei University of Technology (NTUT), Class of 2026. First-author publication at TANET 2025.

Andy Chen (陳奕翔, also known as andynoodles) is a software engineer at ARDGE in Taipei. He built LensCopy, an independent OCR SaaS serving 6,000+ unique visitors per month, and publishes open-source Traditional Chinese OCR datasets on Hugging Face with 5,000+ downloads.

## Profile

- [Personal site](https://andynoodles.github.io/): Full portfolio with experience, projects, and skills

- [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/andynoodles): Published datasets and models
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yi-hsiang-chen-tw/): Professional profile

## Experience

- ARDGE (Jan 2026 – present), Software Engineer: custom vLLM scheduler and GPU-kernel algorithm on a GB300 desktop (2.4× tok/s single-request, 4.3× at 32 concurrent requests); KV-cache management benchmarking (PagedAttention, RadixAttention, LMCache, TurboQuant); production OCR system (95.8%+ accuracy at 1 page/sec); large-scale RAG over 20M+ chunks with sub-500 ms retrieval; agentic customer-service harness built on LLM tool calling
- National Center for High-performance Computing, NCHC (Jul – Dec 2025), Software Engineer Intern: RAG-based customer-service system with LangChain, BM25 hybrid search, and pgvector; Docker/Kubernetes deployment stress-tested to 4,000+ concurrent users

## Projects

- LensCopy:Full-stack AI-powered OCR SaaS — Vue 3, FastAPI, multi-GPU vLLM pipeline, 200+ concurrent inference requests, 10+ orchestrated services with Prometheus/Grafana observability
- Lightweight Code Completion Model Fine-Tuning: end-to-end pipelines to fine-tune Gemma3-270M, Llama-3.2-1B, and Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B with PyTorch, Optuna, and Slurm on NVIDIA H200 clusters; led to a first-author paper at TANET 2025 — [paper PDF](https://andynoodles.github.io/assets/tanet2025-enhancing-slm-agentic-pipelines.pdf)

## Open Source

- [Taiwan Document OCR (zh-TW)](https://huggingface.co/collections/andynoodles/taiwan-document-ocr-zh-tw): 4 block-level OCR datasets, 1.2M+ annotated blocks covering Traditional Chinese government and financial documents from 1928–2024
- [RT-DETR Model Benchmark](https://github.com/andynoodles/PPDocLayout-V3-Benchmark): PP-DocLayoutV3 inference benchmark across PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, and PaddlePaddle, including an upstream ONNX preprocessing bug fix
